observations.title: Read equipped armor details from the armor bar
observations.player_action: Equip different armor pieces and inspect the armor HUD.
observations.outcome: The bar represents armor type, low durability, Mending, Thorns and protection-enchantment information.
conditions: The external page advertises armor trims; match this to installed 2.7.0 before promising every option.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.
